acceptor_id.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for the payment card acceptor (merchant).

acquiring_institution_id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the acquiring institution.

city.description: City of card acceptor. Note that in many cases, particularly in card-not-present transactions, merchants may send through a phone number or URL in this field.

country.description: Country or entity of card acceptor. Possible values are: (1) all ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes, (2) QZZ for Kosovo, and (3) ANT for Netherlands Antilles.

mcc.description: Merchant category code (MCC). A four-digit number listed in ISO 18245. An MCC is used to classify a business by the types of goods or services it provides.
